tracks.label: Matching decompiled C code
tracks.scope: USA Rev 0 (N8ME) loader, resident executable, and both executable overlays; only byte-identical code compiled from .c sources counts.

tracks.label: Matching assembly reference coverage
tracks.scope: Byte-identical .s units retained as disassembly and reverse-engineering reference; excluded from C decompilation progress.

tracks.label: Assembly-assisted C reference coverage
tracks.scope: Byte-identical .c units containing instruction-emitting inline assembly; excluded from C decompilation progress.

tracks.label: Matching initialized program data
tracks.scope: USA Rev 0 initialized data across the loader, resident image, overlays, and overlay data records; only byte-identical reconstructed data counts.

tracks.label: C-decompiled function candidates
tracks.scope: Audited candidate boundaries across the loader, resident image, and both executable overlays; a function counts only when its complete machine code is reproduced from a compiled .c source.

tracks.label: Physical ROM mapping
tracks.scope: Gap-free USA Rev 0 physical address map covering headers, loader, packed program, overlays, archive tables, payloads, and padding; this measures inventory coverage only.

tracks.label: Archive record inventory
tracks.scope: All physical records in the fourteen non-empty USA Rev 0 archives have audited table entries, logical lengths, and aligned physical extents; this is not asset reconstruction.

tracks.label: Physical content classification
tracks.scope: Every archive record has a format-family classification from ROM evidence; classification does not mean its payload has been decoded, extracted, or reconstructed.

tracks.label: Asset reconstruction
tracks.scope: Reconstruction of the inventoried texture, JPEG, model, motion, sprite, audio, auxiliary graphics, gameplay-table, and roster payloads; no completion denominator is established.
